slides.title: The app now speaks your language
slides.body: Switch between Spanish and English whenever you want, from your profile.

slides.title: Home, closer at hand
slides.body: Your monthly KPIs (students, courses, referrals) are now the first thing you see when you open Home.

slides.title: A simpler header
slides.body: "Sign out" now lives in My profile — fewer icons up top, more room for what you use every day.

slides.title: Your instructor card
slides.body: My profile now has its own card: professional level, personal data and favorite currency, all in one place.

slides.title: Revisit it whenever you want
slides.body: Find this again from Help → "What's new", any time you like.
